title: Four Triangles in a Trapezoid | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Two diagonals cut a trapezoid into four triangles, and we only know one area. Vantee finds the other three with similar triangles, shows a fast second way using heights, explains why each wrong answer is tempting, and gives you a new trapezoid to try yourself.
